title: 腳

sentences.text: 工人手忙腳亂，工具掉了。
sentences.spokenText: 工人手忙腳亂工具掉了
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L246-S01 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. In a safe work area, one worker is working and becomes flustered, with a safe hand tool slipping from the worker's hand and landing on the floor. Show the feeling of 手忙腳亂 clearly but without danger or injury.
Visual cast: role identity is worker. The worker is an independent adult role with practical work clothing, visually distinct from protagonist mother, teacher, and L058 adults. L058 lesson images are style references only: warm children's picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed clean environment, expressive preschool proportions. Do not copy any L058 person.
Composition: center the worker, dropped tool, hands, feet, and floor; tool must be safe-looking and phone-readable; keep generous square safe margins.
Mood: mild surprise and everyday busyness, not an accident.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, signs, labels, logos, brands, warning signs, zhuyin, watermarks, injuries, sharp dangerous tools, sparks, fire, or readable marks on tools or clothing.
sentences.imageNotes: 安全的工作場景，一位工人正在工作時手忙腳亂，手上的工具掉到地上。畫面要表現慌亂但不可危險，不要有受傷情節。人物身份要明確：工人。工具不可有品牌、文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.text: 我急急忙忙光著腳出門。
sentences.spokenText: 我急急忙忙光著腳出門
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L246-S02 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At the protagonist family's home doorway, the protagonist little girl is hurrying to go out while barefoot, with her shoes clearly placed beside the door and not yet worn. The protagonist mother stands nearby gently reminding her or holding the shoes.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl follows L154/L162/L163 continuity: pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes visible by the door, small pink hair clip. Protagonist mother follows family continuity: shoulder-length dark hair, white or beige top, wide blue pants, warm family posture, visually distinct from teacher. L058 is style reference only, not character reference.
Composition: center the doorway, barefoot feet, shoes by the door, mother, and little girl; keep the scene calm and safe, not like emergency escape.
Style: warm refined watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft home light, clean Taiwan home entry.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, door plates, signs, labels, logos, brands, zhuyin, watermarks, panic, danger, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在家門口急急忙忙要出門，還光著腳，鞋子放在門邊沒有穿上。主角媽媽可在旁邊提醒或拿鞋，但不要讓畫面像危險逃跑。人物身份要明確：主角小女孩、主角媽媽。不可有文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.text: 山腳下的河水流得很急。
sentences.spokenText: 山腳下的河水流得很急
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L246-S03 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At the foot of a mountain, a small river flows very quickly after rain. The protagonist little girl and protagonist mother stand at a safe distance watching the fast river, clearly away from the water edge.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl follows L154/L162/L163 continuity with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Protagonist mother follows family continuity with shoulder-length dark hair, white or beige top, wide blue pants. L058 is style reference only, not character reference.
Composition: make the mountain foot, fast river flow, and safe viewing distance clear in one square frame. Use moving water shapes but avoid disaster imagery.
Style: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, natural outdoor light after rain, safe calm mood.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, warning signs, labels, road signs, water level marks, zhuyin, watermarks, danger, flooding disaster, people near deep water, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 山腳下有一條小河，雨後河水流得很快。主角小女孩和主角媽媽站在安全距離外看河水，不靠近水邊。畫面重點是山腳下的位置與河水流得很急，不要做災害場面。人物身份要明確：主角小女孩、主角媽媽。不可有文字、數字、警示牌或標籤。

sentences.text: 車要開走了，媽媽幫我拿包。
sentences.spokenText: 車要開走了媽媽幫我拿包
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L246-S04 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At a safe roadside or station area, a vehicle is preparing to leave. The protagonist mother helps the protagonist little girl by carrying or handing her bag while the little girl is hurrying to board, both staying at a safe distance from the vehicle.
Visual cast: protagonist mother follows L154/L162/L163 continuity: shoulder-length dark hair, white or beige top, wide blue pants, warm practical family role. Protagonist little girl follows L154/L162/L163 continuity: pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. L058 is style reference only.
Composition: center mother helping with the bag, little girl, and vehicle; keep the vehicle plain and phone-readable without any route or plate details.
Style: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor illustration, safe daily transit mood.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, license plates, route signs, vehicle logos, station signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, crowding, traffic danger, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 車站或路邊安全場景，一輛車準備開走，主角媽媽幫主角小女孩拿包，主角小女孩看起來趕著要上車但保持安全距離。車子不可有車牌號碼、路線文字、數字、標誌或標籤。人物身份要明確：主角媽媽、主角小女孩。

sentences.text: 老師叫我幫忙做手作道具。
sentences.spokenText: 老師叫我幫忙做手作道具
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story

Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. In a classroom or activity room, the recurring teacher asks the protagonist little girl to help make handmade props. On the table are plain paper, solid color material blocks, and safe craft materials with no writing.
Visual cast: recurring teacher identity: adult teacher, tidy classroom clothing, calm instructional posture, visually distinct from protagonist mother; do not use the mother's yellow or coral-red palette, and do not make the teacher look like a family role or the L058 adult woman. Protagonist little girl follows L154/L162/L163 continuity with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. L058 images are style references only, not person references.
Composition: center teacher, protagonist little girl, and tabletop craft props; make helping and handcraft prop-making clear; keep all materials safe and phone-readable.
Style: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, clean classroom light, gentle expressions.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, blackboard writing, labels, logos, brands, zhuyin, watermarks, readable marks on paper/materials, scissors in a dangerous position, or copied L058 people.
sentences.imageNotes: 教室或活動教室場景，老師請主角小女孩幫忙做手作道具，桌上有紙、色塊材料和安全手作材料。老師要依 LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP 設計，不可以長得像主角媽媽；不要用媽媽的黃色或珊瑚紅配色，不要像家庭角色。人物身份要明確：老師、主角小女孩。不可有文字、數字或標籤。
